ashen_compact.prompt:
Create an original dark-fantasy pixel-art SPRITE SHEET PNG with a TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND (alpha channel, empty pixels have alpha 0). Square layout: 4 columns x 4 rows, 15 isolated sprites with generous clear spacing, last cell empty. Every sprite entirely inside its cell, including spear tips and banners. Consistent southeast three-quarter view. Restrained charcoal iron, warm ochre and bone cloth, dull brass; practical rectangular equipment, gabled timber and kiln-brick buildings. Culture: Ashen Compact, displaced craft households bound by public oaths. Original emblem: open square hearth frame enclosing an ember diamond. Adult proportions, weathered materials, crisp hard pixel edges, upper-left light. No text or labels.
Row1: caravan traveler with covered cart; hooded scout with bow; guard sword/square shield; infantry upright pike.
Row2: heavily armored shield infantry; armored horse and rider; officer with baton and pennant; surveyor with rolled chart and staff.
Row3: engineer apron/hammer/satchel; small workshop village; larger market town; fortified gabled city.
Row4: square-hearth crest; same emblem on standing narrow banner; simplified same emblem badge; empty.
EXPORT PNG WITH REAL TRANSPARENCY; the area around the sprites is empty alpha, suitable for compositing directly onto a game map.
